name: Mother Ivey's Bay Holiday Park
stayType: Holiday park with hire caravans, camping and touring
accommodation: Hire caravans in several grades (including assisted living), camping pitches, touring and motorhome pitches, and holiday homes for sale
dogs: Has a dog-friendly section on its website
beachAccess: The park has a sandy beach where children can play and swim
confirmedFeatures: Hire caravans, camping and touring pitches, Wi-Fi, accessibility information, web cam
overview: A holiday park on the headland between Harlyn Bay and Trevose Head, offering hire caravans in a range of grades alongside camping, touring and motorhome pitches. The park has its own golden sandy beach and publishes Wi-Fi, accessibility and park plan information online. Harlyn Bay is a short drive or coastal walk away.
surfTripFit: A range of caravan grades and pitches gives options for every budget, with several north-coast surf beaches nearby.
